title: 〜だけましだ
meaning: at least …; it could be worse; it is something that …
simpleExplanation: 〜だけましだ finds the one good point in a bad situation: "the pay is low, but at least I have a job". まし means "better than the alternative". The speaker admits the situation is not good, then names the thing that makes it bearable. The tone is consoling or realistic.
whenUsed: Spoken and casual written Japanese, everyday consolation and self-consolation. Often preceded by a complaint with が / けど and followed by と思う / と思わなければ. Polite: 〜だけましです.
formation: Vる / Vた / Vない + だけましだ
いA + だけましだ  (近いだけましだ)
なA + な + だけましだ  (静かなだけましだ)
N + な / である + だけましだ

examples.ja: 給料は安いが、仕事があるだけましだ。
examples.reading: きゅうりょうはやすいが、しごとがあるだけましだ。
examples.en: The pay is low, but at least I have a job.
examples.note: Low pay is the complaint; having a job at all is the consolation.

examples.ja: けがはしたが、命が助かっただけましだと思う。
examples.reading: けがはしたが、いのちがたすかっただけましだとおもう。
examples.en: I was injured, but I think it is a blessing just to have survived.
examples.note: Vた + だけましだ: surviving is the consolation after an injury.

examples.ja: 家は狭いが、駅に近いだけましだ。
examples.reading: いえはせまいが、えきにちかいだけましだ。
examples.en: The house is small, but at least it is close to the station.
examples.note: いA + だけましだ: 近い attaches directly.

examples.ja: 遅刻はしたが、会議に間に合っただけましだと思おう。
examples.reading: ちこくはしたが、かいぎにまにあっただけましだとおもおう。
examples.en: I was late, but let me be glad I at least made it to the meeting.
examples.note: だけましだと思う / 思おう is a common frame.

examples.ja: この部屋は狭いけれど、日当たりがいいだけまだましだ。
examples.reading: このへやはせまいけれど、ひあたりがいいだけまだましだ。
examples.en: This room is small, but at least it gets good sunlight, which is something.
examples.note: まだまし strengthens "still better than the alternative".

similarGrammar.difference: Same pattern from N2. At N1, watch the attachment to な-adjectives (静かな + だけ) and the contrast with だけあって.
"As expected of X" (positive quality explains a good result). だけましだ is about consolation in a bad situation.
"Even if not X, at least Y" (a lower standard is met). だけましだ names what makes a bad situation bearable.

commonMistakes.wrong: 給料が高いだけましだ。
commonMistakes.right: 給料は安いが、仕事があるだけましだ。
commonMistakes.why: The situation must be bad overall; the だけ part is the small saving grace. A good point on its own does not need consolation.
な-adjectives need な before だけ.

commonMistakes.wrong: 命が助かったのはだけましだ。
commonMistakes.right: 命が助かっただけましだ。
commonMistakes.why: だけ attaches directly to the plain form; no のは.

usageNotes: The complaint is usually stated first with が / けど, then the consolation with だけましだ.
まし on its own means "the lesser evil": Aより B のほうがましだ.
Polite forms (だけましです・だけましでしょう) are fine in conversation with acquaintances.
jlptTips: In 文法形式の判断, a complaint + が + a small good point + a blank is だけましだ. Look for consolation words like せめて or まだ.
Distractor だけあって: it explains a good result by a good cause and never appears in a consoling context.
In 並べ替え, keep the good point immediately before だけましだ.
